en: I found a guy named Rocus Las Flores in Araras, the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia, in Linares.{wait}{clear}Um, he's a clergyman, and I heard he's really supposed to become Pope.{wait}{clear}But to me he just looked like he was drifting around. Is he gonna be okay...?{wait}{clear}B-but if you talk to him, Angel, I bet he'll become a hero! Go meet him, okay?

I found a girl named Irene Tirnag in a place called Darg on Bremes Isle.{wait}{clear}She's a little girl who lives with a big owl, in a really tall tower.{wait}{clear}Um, it looks like she studies magic there every day.{wait}{clear}I don't really get the hard stuff, but I can feel really strong magic in her.{wait}{clear}I'm sure she'll become a hero and help you, Angel. So go meet her, okay?

I found a woman named Leyla Vigrid in Reizefut, the capital of the Grosain Empire, in Reizefut.{wait}{clear}Being the first woman ever to become a knight is amazing enough, but it looks like she was a captain of an order of knights, too.{wait}{clear}But right now she's in jail. I heard she has a really strong sense of justice, so why would that be...?{wait}{clear}Angel, I don't think she's a bad person. So please help her! Please!

I found a girl named Cecia in Leiria, in Fes in the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}She's from a clan that lives in a super big forest called Reyforia, and they say she's an expert archer.{wait}{clear}And she's really pure, and I get the feeling she wants to meet you, Angel.{wait}{clear}So I'm sure she'll help you, Angel. Go meet her, okay?

Angeeel! Angel!! The hero tried really hard, but the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia has fallen to the Empire...!{wait}{clear}The city got wrecked, and the cathedral got burned down...{wait}{clear}Lots of people died, but it looks like some managed to get away.{wait}{clear}I'm really worried about what's gonna happen to Arcaya now. Angel!! The Heavenly Dragon has finally come back!{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon is the incarnation of Satan's soul, and it's swallowing up towns and people one after another!!{wait}{clear}The end of the world is only a matter of time! Angel, join forces with the heroes and protect Arcaya!!

Angel!! A hero defeated Clarence, the one called Viper, who stole the Demon Stone from the Holy Nation of Ecclesia!{wait}{clear}It looks like he couldn't find any hope in this world, so he sided with the Empire...

Angel!! A hero defeated Alberic, the imperial knight!{wait}{clear}It looks like he wanted things other people recognize, like honor, and a devil used that feeling... In the end the demon sword took him over.
Angel!! A hero defeated Ravenruft, the vampire king.{wait}{clear}It looks like he was a hero who got soaked in tons of the Heavenly Dragon's blood in the battle against it a thousand years ago...
Angel! A hero defeated Ravenruft, the vampire king.{wait}{clear}Now people on the frontier will hardly ever get attacked by the undead, I bet!

The castle of the legendary Crimson Moon King and the devil possessing Endymion have shown up!{wait}{clear}If we don't beat that devil and the Heavenly Dragon, peace won't ever come back to Arcaya!{wait}{clear}Angel, please defeat the devil and the Heavenly Dragon with the heroes and save the world!!
